name: BIOL 2289
title: Introduction to Undergraduate Research
description: Introduction to the variety of research programs in the Life Sciences on the Storrs campus. Required of Sophomore Biology Honor students; also open to students interested in undergraduate research. With a change of content, this course may be repeated for credit. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: BIOL 1107 and 1108 or equivalent.
